_source: MACE foundation models. MACE-OFF: neutral organic molecules (H, C, N, O, F, P, S, Cl, Br, I). MACE-MP-0: inorganic / materials across the periodic table. Larger sizes trade speed for accuracy. The value (e.g. 'MACE-OFF medium') is stored on the calc; the MLIP runner maps it to the matching loader (mace_off / mace_mp) and model size.

MACE-MP-0 (materials)._note: Inorganic / periodic systems; loaded via mace_mp(model=...).
